sentences.text:
Jitendra Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 January,
2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Gwl:6
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vivek Jain
 On The 2 nd Of January, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 60071 of 2025
 Jitendra Sharma
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Rajmani Bansal - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Atul Sharma - Public Prosecutor for the State.

Order 
The present application has been filed under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita Adhiniyam, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending arrest in connection with Crime No.22 of 2023 registered at Police Station Kailaras, District Morena (M.P.)
for offences punishable under Section 420 of IPC and further added Sections 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.

It is contended by counsel for applicant that as per prosecution version, the documents of applicant were forwarded to police station for verification of his criminal antecedents for the reason that he has been selected and appointed in Food Corporation of India.
During the process, it was found that entire recruitment process never took place and no advertisement was issued by Food Corporation of India for recruitment.
On these allegations, the present applicant has been made an accused in the present case.
It is argued that FIR is named against three persons who have been allegedly fraudulently appointed in such manner namely, Ravindra Dhakad, Jitendra Sharma and Vinay Sharma.

Co-accused Vinay Sharma has already been bailed out by this Court and granted the benefit of anticipatory bail in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:6 2 MCRC-60071-2025 MCRC No.44802/2025 by order dated 22/12/2025 and the case of present applicant is at par with that of co-accused Vinay Sharma.
It is further contended that there is no apprehension that he would abscond during pendency of investigation and trial, as the case may be.
He would cooperate in the investigation and trial.
On these grounds, he may be allowed the benefit of anticipatory bail.

3. Per contra, learned C ounsel for the State in his turn has vehemently opposed the present anticipatory bail application but could not point out any distinguishing feature from the case of Vinay Sharma to the case of present applicant Jitendra Sharma.

sentences.text: 4. Considering the aforesaid rival contentions, this Court deems it appropriate to grant the benefit of anticipatory bail to the applicant - Jitendra Sharma.

5. It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority/trial Court.
6. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

7. Application stands allowed and disposed of .
8.
